# onpager_user_phone_contact (Resource)

Manage one employee phone contact using the tenant permission `user_phone_contacts.manage`. The method can be read and deleted after the employee loses access to the voice channel. Destroy deletes the exact method and clears its references in retained notification policy steps. Administrative confirmation places no call.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "user_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "UUID of the user who will receive calls."
}

variable "voice_channel_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "UUID of an enabled Zvonok.com voice provider available to the user."
}

variable "phone" {
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  description = "Full E.164 telephone number."
}

variable "template_contact_id" {
  type        = string
  default     = null
  description = "UUID of the phone slot in the user's notification defaults, when completing a draft."
}

resource "terraform_data" "phone_creation" {
  triggers_replace = [var.user_id, var.voice_channel_id, var.template_contact_id]
}

resource "onpager_user_phone_contact" "oncall" {
  user_id             = var.user_id
  channel_id          = var.voice_channel_id
  display_name        = "On-call phone"
  phone               = var.phone
  verified            = true
  request_id          = terraform_data.phone_creation.id
  template_contact_id = var.template_contact_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) Voice channel UUID accessible to the owner during writes. Changing the channel replaces the method. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.
- `display_name` (String) Mutable contact label of 1–200 UTF-8 characters without NUL or surrounding whitespace.
- `user_id` (String) Owner user UUID. Changing the user replaces the method. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID.

### Optional

- `phone` (String, Sensitive) E.164 phone number with a plus sign and 8–15 digits. Required on create and replacement. Terraform stores the full configured number in sensitive state. OnPager returns only its masked suffix and target UUID. Omit or set null to keep the current binding after import or on update. Refresh clears the stored number when the target UUID changes. A configured number is restored on the next apply.
- `request_id` (String) Create request UUID. Supply a stable UUID before creation, for example from terraform_data. Keep it for retries of the same create and supply a fresh UUID when recreating a deleted contact. Changing the configured value replaces the contact. May be omitted on import. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID when set.
- `template_contact_id` (String) Contact UUID in the tenant user notification defaults template. Set it to complete the matching user's untouched draft in place and preserve its policy references. Omit to create a separate method. Changing the configured slot replaces the resource. The API does not return this value on import. Must be a nonzero canonical lowercase UUID when set.
- `verified` (Boolean) Set true to confirm the exact configured phone on its voice channel. Set false to revoke confirmation. Omission or null leaves verification under OnPager control. New and replaced numbers default to unverified. A rename preserves confirmation. Terraform records the observed status on read.

### Read-Only

- `draft` (Boolean) Whether the contact is an unfilled draft.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether OnPager currently enables the method.
- `generation` (Number) Observed verification generation. Phone updates and deletion use the scoped method UUID without a revision precondition.
- `id` (String) Stable phone method UUID. Import with `user_uuid/method_uuid`.
- `masked_phone` (String, Sensitive) Masked suffix returned by OnPager. Empty for an unfilled draft.
- `target_id` (String) Opaque UUID of the current destination. A number change can change this UUID even when the masked suffix is identical.

## Zvonok.com and telephone verification

Set `channel_id` to the ID of an enabled Zvonok.com voice provider available to
the user. Set `configuration.base_url` on the voice provider to use a mock
endpoint. Omit it to use the standard Zvonok.com API. The personal contact supplies the recipient number. See
[voice provider configuration](voice_provider.md).

Supply the full E.164 number on creation. With `verified = true`, Control
confirms that exact number on that voice channel without placing a call.
Omitting verification creates an unverified contact. Renaming preserves its
verification. Changing the number clears verification unless the configuration
also confirms the new number. Set `verified = false` to revoke confirmation.

The API returns a masked number and an opaque `target_id`. Refresh keeps the
known full number while the target stays the same. A changed target invalidates
the stored number, even when its last four digits match. A configured number
can then be reconciled. Full numbers are sensitive and persist in Terraform
state and saved plans.

## Create identity and template contacts

Supply a stable `request_id` before the first apply. The example uses the UUID
of a built-in `terraform_data` resource. A retry with the same initial inputs
and UUID recovers the original method after a lost response. Keep the UUID
through in-place updates. Control reserves it after deletion. To recreate with
unchanged configuration, replace the corresponding `terraform_data` resource
to obtain a fresh UUID. Different request UUIDs can create multiple contacts
for the same user and channel.

To complete a draft that a user's notification policies already reference, set
`template_contact_id` to the contact slot UUID in the tenant notification
defaults. Create the user after the defaults have been applied and order the
contact after any required access grant. Control fills the matching untouched
draft in place and preserves its method UUID. A changed or occupied slot can
return a conflict. Omitting the slot creates a separate method.

Destroy deletes the owned method, including a completed draft. Policy steps
retain their positions and their method references become null. Recreating the
contact gives it a new UUID. Update the affected policies to use that UUID.

## Import

Use `user_uuid/method_uuid`. The second UUID is the personal method's `id`.
Omit `request_id` and `template_contact_id` when adopting an existing contact.
Control does not return these creation inputs. Adding them to the configuration
after import requests replacement. The read returns the masked number. Omit `phone` to manage an imported contact without setting a full number. To confirm the contact explicitly, configure the exact full number.

Example import block

```terraform
import {
  to = onpager_user_phone_contact.oncall
  id = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
}
```

Equivalent CLI command

```shell
terraform import onpager_user_phone_contact.oncall 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555
```


## Permissions

Requires OnPager Control 0.0.10 or later and the tenant grant
`user_phone_contacts.manage` for the PAT or service account. An authorized administrator
can read or delete an existing method after the user loses access to its
channel. Access and transport errors retain the resource in Terraform state.
